set.body: From the S5.5 review (s55-geometry). (1) Backend placement preview: thumbnails/density place records in studio-core (SourcePositions: own CSV parse, occurrence default 1, no key trimming; CorrectionLedger.place: correction-then-contains) using eyes4s primitives. Agreement is tested only for the default policy on on-screen golden data. Add a StudyBackend 'placement preview' (per-record placement + per-trial WindowTally for a spec, drafts included) that replaces SourcePositions and CorrectionLedger.place; this also makes the per-trial 'n of m outside' thumbnail labels trace to an eyes4s tally instead of StudioRef.Trial (GeometryPanelVM ~253). (2) Off-screen agreement fixture: the golden has 0 off-screen records, so the OutsideScreen branch agrees with eyes4s only by construction; add a synthetic source with off-screen records under QuarantineTrial and ExcludeRecord compared with eyes4s rejected/quarantined output. (3) Overlapping correction rules are pre-checked only in GeometryPanel once positions are loaded (GeometryPanel.scala ~368); move the invariant into the Reducer (AddCorrection / ImportSources) via AdmissionPolicy.correctionFor. (4) 250 ms redraw AC is measured (36 receipts: min 21, median 33, max 237.7 ms) but asserted at 1000 ms (GeometryPanelFxSuite ~70); add a headless timing check on GeometryPictures.of over the 11,520-record golden, or tighten. (5) CountVM.ref is carried but not clickable. (6) A new draft shows the parent's counts until real admission (S3.7).
set.title: S5.5 follow-ups: backend placement preview, off-screen agreement, reducer overlap check, redraw timing
